# Paper Library PDF Fixtures

The paper-library workflow tests use small synthetic PDFs or generated in-test
files. Keep binary fixtures minimal and non-copyrighted.

Required fixture categories:

- `embedded-title.pdf`: valid PDF whose embedded metadata title is reliable.
- `first-page-title.pdf`: valid PDF with missing or unreliable embedded title
  metadata and a clear visible first-page title.
- `duplicate-renamed.pdf`: byte-identical or fingerprint-identical copy of a
  known valid paper with a different local filename.
- `strong-metadata-duplicate.pdf`: different PDF bytes with normalized title
  plus author or year matching an existing paper strongly.
- `fuzzy-match.pdf`: similar title or metadata that should enter maintainer
  review rather than automatic duplicate rejection.
- `not-a-pdf.txt`: unsupported type.
- `empty.pdf`: zero-byte or effectively empty PDF upload.
- `corrupted.pdf`: malformed PDF that cannot be parsed.
- `password-blocked.pdf`: encrypted PDF without inspectable content.
- `oversized.pdf`: generated by test helper to exceed the configured paper
  upload limit; avoid committing a large binary file.

Self-check: every category above is represented by a committed tiny fixture or
by an explicit test helper that generates the case at runtime.
